task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First step, try to go to the south. That done, make an effort to travel east. Then, travel south. And then, make an effort to head east. Okay, and then, make an attempt to venture north. After that, take a trip north. Then, take a trip west. Then, make an attempt to travel south. And then, make an effort to venture east. After that, make an effort to venture east. Next, attempt to go to the south. And then, attempt to head east. Then, attempt to move south. Okay, and then, try to go to the east. With that done, venture south. Okay, and then, make an effort to take a trip west. And then, go to the west. Then, try to travel north. Following that, try to go north. Then, try to travel west. With that accomplished, venture north. Once you accomplish that, make an effort to venture north. After that, try to move west. After that, make an effort to move west. Then, make an effort to travel west. And then, try to move south. Then, venture south. And then, move west. And then, venture north. And then, retrieve the coin from the floor of the cookery. Got that? Good!
